title: AIBE 22 admit card 2026 releasing tomorrow; check exam-day guidelines - Business Standard
text:

 Home / Education / News / AIBE 22 admit card 2026 releasing tomorrow; check exam-day guidelines AIBE 22 admit card 2026 releasing tomorrow; check exam-day guidelines
 AIBE 22 (XXII) admit card 2026 will be issued tomorrow on Nov 14, 2026. The exam is planned to be held on Nov 29, 2026, and candidates can download their admit cards from the official website
 AIBE 22 admit card 2026 Date
 Princess Sonika New Delhi 2 min read Last Updated : Nov 13 2026 | 5:16 PM IST Listen to This Article
 AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 will be released by the Bar Council of India (BCI) for the All India Bar Examination XXII on November 14, 2026, via the official website. The examination is scheduled for November 29, 2026. All candidates must download their admit card from the official website before taking the exam.    Although the exact time for the AIBE 22 admit card release is not provided, the council anticipates making the hall ticket available in the evening. To obtain the admit card, candidates must input their registered login ID and password. How to download AIBE 22 Hall Ticket 2026?
 Visit the official website at allindiabarexamination.com     Find and click on the "AIBE XXII (22) Admit Card" link.   Fill in your Login ID and password into the designated fields. Also Read

   The AIBE admit card 2026 will be showcased on your screen.   Download and print a copy of the AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 for later use and for the exam day. Details Mentioned on AIBE 2026 Admit Card
 All India Bar Examination (AIBE) XXII is planned for Sunday, November 29, 2026. The examination is expected to take place from 1:00 PM to 4:00 PM. Candidates must arrive at their assigned exam centre by 11:30 AM. The gate-closing time is 1:15 PM.   Candidates can find the following details on the admit card:   Candidate’s Name   Roll Number   Exam Center Name and Address   Exam Date and Timings   Important Exam-Day Instructions.    ALSO READ:  Chhath Puja 2026: Delhi and other state schools to remain closed on Nov 16 Documents to carry with AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026
 Applicants must bring specific documents to the examination centre alongside their AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 for confirmation. Not bringing these documents could result in being refused entry.   Printed copy of the AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 (with visible information)   One valid photo ID proof in original (e.g., Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Passport, Driving License)   Blue/Black Ball Point Pen   Bare Acts or Bare Acts with short notes/comments (Bare Acts without notes and comments are preferred).   ALSO READ:  RRB Group D result 2026 out; check zone-wise category, cut offs and more   More From This Section
